title: Cowork Mode
description: Declarative configuration of a Cowork mode: law, commands, panel and browser feed. Validate your config file against this schema before loading it into your app.

id.description: Stable mode identifier (used in the event log and commands).

label.description: Label shown in the UI (pill, tab, panel header).

icon.description: Icon identifier in your app's icon set (e.g. 'monitor').

description.description: Short text explaining the mode (tooltip / help).

activateCommand.description: Slash command name (without '/') that activates the mode.

deactivateCommand.description: Slash command name (without '/') that deactivates the mode.

path.description: Path or URL of the markdown with the mode law (e.g. law/cowork-core.md).

header.description: Header prefixed to the law on injection, making clear it is NOT a user message.

injection.description: Where the law goes. 'system-prompt-section' is recommended (re-evaluated on every prompt assembly); the others are fallbacks for hosts without a dynamic system prompt.

activate.description: Command that activates the mode (e.g. /cowork). Must record an event in the session log.

eventType.description: Type of the durable event that records the mode switch (e.g. 'command/run').

recordInput.description: MUST be false: the command must not echo into the conversation as a message.

placement.description: Where the mode panel is rendered.

timer.description: Show the task timer (mm:ss) in the panel header.

liveBrowser.description: Show the latest screenshot published by the agent (object-fit: contain, panel full-bleed).

steerInput.description: Text box in the panel footer to steer the task without leaving the mode.

iterationPrefix.description: Prefix added to steering messages after the first one.

deliverablesList.description: List files cited by the agent as deliverables (extracted from session text).

objectFit.description: Fit of the screenshot inside the panel. 'contain' shows the whole capture.

provider.description: Provider of the browser the agent operates.

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the provider API key (server-side only).

screenshotUrlPattern.description: Regex (as string) matching screenshot URLs in session text.

pollIntervalMs.description: Panel refresh interval when the feed is polling-based (alternative: reactive on session events).

directoryTemplate.description: Deliverables directory template (e.g. '$COWORK_DIR/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>/'). Must match the law.

absolutePaths.description: Require absolute paths in deliverables (lets the panel link/list them).
